scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplies infinite-domain claims; deterministic quadrature is supplementary; renewal formula and matrix Laplace technique are not presented as independently invented.
scientific_limitations: Stationary density along fixed rays only; isotropic scalar relaxation, centered SPD Gaussian reset and diffusion covariances. No uniformity at angular phase boundaries, no arbitrary noncommuting drift, no independent publication-priority certification.
title: Interior-age domination and five sharp Gaussian-tail regimes under anisotropic resetting
